question: What Speed Limit (R2-1) sign sizes are shown in Table 2B-1 for conventional single-lane, conventional multi-lane, expressway, and freeway applications?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Table 2B-1 (Regulatory Sign and Plaque Sizes) lists the Speed Limit (R2-1) sign, per Section 2B.21, at 24 x 30 inches for single-lane conventional roads, 30 x 36 inches for multi-lane conventional roads, 36 x 48 inches for expressways, and 48 x 60 inches for freeways. The table also shows a minimum size of 18 x 24 inches and an oversized size of 30 x 36 inches (all dimensions width x height, in inches). Standards (mandatory): - While the size values themselves appear in Table 2B-1, the governing Standard for the sign's use states: "The Speed Limit (R2-1) sign (see Figure 2B-3) shall display the limit established by law, ordinance, regulation, or as adopted by the authorized agency based on an engineering study. The speed limits displayed shall be in multiples of 5 mph." - "Speed Limit (R2-1) signs, indicating speed limits for which posting is required by law, shall be located at the points of change from one speed limit to another." Guidance (recommended): - For school-area use of the R2-1, the Oversized column sizes "should be used on roadways that have four or more lanes with posted speed limits of 40 mph or higher" (Table 7B-1 shows the school-use R2-1 at 24 x 30 conventional, 36 x 48 oversized), which contextualizes but does not replace the Table 2B-1 sizes. Visual evidence: - [Image 5] shows Table 2B-1 (Sheet 1 of 6), where the Speed Limit (R2-1) row (Section 2B.21) reads: Single Lane 24 x 30, Multi-Lane 30 x 36, Expressway 36 x 48, Freeway 48 x 60, Minimum 18 x 24, Oversized 30 x 36. - [Image 1] (Figure 2B-3) illustrates the R2-1 Speed Limit sign design and its related plaques referenced by Table 2B-1. - [Image 2] (Table 7B-1) shows the separate school-use R2-1 sizes (24 x 30 conventional; 36 x 48 oversized), which differ from the general Table 2B-1 values. - [Image 4] (Table 6G-1) shows the temporary traffic control R2-1 sizes (24 x 30 conventional road; 36 x 48 freeway or expressway), also distinct from Table 2B-1. Citations: - Section 2B.21 Standard §13 (p.85) - Section 2B.21 Standard §14 (p.85) - Section 7B.01 Guidance §3 (p.972) - Figure 2B-3 (p.86) - Table 7B-1 (p.971) - Table 6G-1 (p.796) - Page 109
gold_answer: 24 x 30, 30 x 36, 36 x 48, and 48 x 60 inches, respectively.
